clauses.reason: EO 11499 amends section 2 of EO 11248 (level V) by deleting item (21), Assistant Archivist, Office of Presidential Libraries, and inserting item (21), Commissioner, Transportation and Communications Service, General Services Administration. EO 11604 and EO 11634 only renumbered the item. No held later order amends or deletes it. Section 2 of EO 11708 lists a “Commissioner, Property Management and Disposal Service, General Services Administration”, a different office. EO 11708 section 3 provides “Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2” and “Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked”; the eight level V positions continued by section 2 of EO 11708 do not include the Commissioner of the Transportation and Communications Service, so the placement was revoked on March 23, 1973 (signing date; EO 11708 has no effective-date provision). First end: express revocation of the parent order as amended.

research_rationale:
EO 11499 (signed 1969-12-11; 34 FR 19645) was read in full in the held Federal Register text layer. Acting under section 5317 of title 5, U.S. Code, it amends section 2 of Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, by deleting level V item (21), Assistant Archivist, Office of Presidential Libraries, General Services Administration, and inserting in its place item (21), Commissioner, Transportation and Communications Service, General Services Administration. The order's one operative clause is that placement; the deletion of the earlier item was performed when the order took effect. EO 11604 (1971-07-02) and EO 11634 (1971-12-06) only renumbered the item (items (9) through (24) as (8) through (23), then items (9) through (20) as (8) through (19)). EO 11708 (signed 1973-03-23) section 3 revoked EO 11248 as amended except the eight level V positions in its section 2, which include a Commissioner of the Property Management and Disposal Service but not the Commissioner of the Transportation and Communications Service, so the clause first ended on 1973-03-23 by express revocation of the parent order as amended, which is also the whole-order end. The General Services Administration reorganization of the Service is not held and is not relied on; the item stayed in EO 11248 as amended, and was renumbered by two later orders, until EO 11708, and I found no held instrument that extinguished it earlier. Original not an authenticated transcription: the held text is the OCR text layer of the official Federal Register issue; quotations avoid its recognition errors.
